entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Vivek Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anuj Singh, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the records.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 307 of 2020, under Sections 506, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406 I.P.C, Police Station Jagdishpur, District Amethi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 31.08.2020 against eleven persons, including the applicant, alleging that the accused persons induced the informant and various other persons for making investment in Eye Vision India Credit Cooperation Society Limited and the amount invested was not refunded.

entities.text: Eye Vision India Credit Cooperation Society Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is specifically stated in the affidavit filed in support of the bail application that the applicant is neither director nor any other position holder in the society in question and he is not even an agent of the same.

6. The applicant's criminal history of 75 cases has been disclosed in paragraph 14 of the affidavit, all of which relate to transactions of the aforesaid society and in 41 of which the applicant has been granted bail.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that in case co-accused Rajesh Kumar Vishwakarma has already been granted bail in the present case by means of order dated 08.09.2022 passed by this Court in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 10211 of 2022.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 10211 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant claims that he does not hold any principal position in the company/society in question; that the applicant has been granted bail in several other cases of similar nature and that one of the co-accused persons have been granted bail in the present case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023/Preeti.
